description: Test discovery through purchase, account, onboarding, assessment, Journey, completion, and membership access.

packageTestScript.nearest: local Puppeteer enrollment walk + production HTTP/browser probes

productionBuild.reason: Ops status file only. No production application, marketing, or legal files changed.

evidence: Production homepage Become an Architect CTA navigates to /register
Production /journey loads seven chapters
Local homepage CTA and /journey load
Catalog shows Blueprint $1,500, Founding Architect $1,750, Community $50/month
Unconfirmed visitors hitting /checkout/{offer} redirect to /eligibility
Eligible unauthenticated visitors redirect to /login?next=/checkout/{offer}
Authenticated local Founding Architect form loads; Stripe session is not_configured without sandbox key
purchase.notExecuted: Live Stripe Checkout charge, webhook entitlement grant, receipts

evidence: 18+ gate then registration form (first/last/email/password + four legal acknowledgments)
Local email registration creates account and lands on /register/confirmation (verify-email required)
Unverified login remains on /login
Verified login reaches /architect/dashboard
Spanish /es/register loads
journey_access incomplete user is redirected dashboard → /architect/onboarding/welcome
Not-entitled user is redirected to /checkout?need=journey_access
Community-only user is redirected to /architect/dashboard (community_only)
onboarding.gap: Automated Continue on welcome did not change URL; remaining onboarding steps (preferences, consent, lumina, assessment, awakening) were not click-completed in this run.

evidence: Entitled user can open /architect/assessment/aliveness
Completed user Journey entry exposes View Aliveness Results
assessment.gap: Full 45-statement Aliveness Index was not filled and submitted in the browser.

evidence: Not-entitled → /checkout?need=journey_access
Entitled completed onboarding loads /architect/journey with Chapter One and chapter entry controls
Seeded completed user reaches /architect/journey/chapter-7/welcome
Journey entry shows REVIEW CHAPTER SEVEN
Code path: completing Chapter VII records journey_completed
completion.gap: Chapters I–VII were not click-completed from empty state in this run.

evidence: Unauthenticated /architect/* redirects to eligibility then login
No journey_access: dashboard without Journey, onboarding/journey blocked
Bundle-seeded user billing: Journey access active and Community access active; Architect Resources reachable
Community-only billing: Community access active and Journey access not active
membership.gap: Membership was granted via local entitlement seed, not a live Stripe purchase. Billing showed no purchases/invoices on file.

flows.name: Register 18+ gate then form
flows.detail: Yes, I am 18 or older → first/last/email/password + four consents. Form not submitted on production.

localAuthenticatedWalk.note: File-store seeds only. No production accounts created. No live charges.

findings.name: Canonical public domain did not resolve from this environment
findings.detail: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND thebackhalf.org and www.thebackhalf.org. Enrollment probes used https://website-two-psi-49.vercel.app. DNS/nameservers were not modified.

findings.name: Live paid purchase path not executed
findings.detail: Stripe configuration is out of scope. No sandbox key in this environment. A live charge was not created. Row 179 covers payment/subscription testing.

findings.name: Billing entitlements persist in a local file store
findings.detail: getBillingStore() uses createFileBillingStore(). Auth users can persist in Postgres when configured. Production post-purchase membership durability after webhook grant was not live-verified.

findings.name: Onboarding Continue from welcome did not advance in automation
findings.detail: Welcome loaded at /architect/onboarding/welcome. Automated Continue left the same URL. Preferences through awakening were not click-completed.

findings.name: Assessment and Journey completion were not click-walked from empty state
findings.detail: Assessment route opened. Completed-user Chapter VII welcome opened. Full Aliveness Index and seven-chapter completion were not filled in the browser.

findings.name: No production test accounts used
findings.detail: Row 176 production test accounts were not available in this run. Local file-store seeds were used for authenticated stages.

notClaimed: Live Stripe Checkout charge, webhook signature success, receipts, or refunds
Canonical thebackhalf.org DNS from this Cloud Agent environment
Click-complete of every onboarding step, Aliveness Index, and chapters I–VII from empty state
nextAction: Row 179 should execute sandbox/live payment and webhook recovery. Canonical DNS reachability remains a launch-domain check (Row 75). Command Center row 178 stays open. Kimberly Walker (human) remains the sole Founder acceptance authority.
